notes.title: Mordfield Command Map Editor Receives Update
notes.content: [p]Exciting update![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004847/743fef5b277205399f672125d6b947afa4d5f6bf.png"][/img][/p][p]Leader developer Josh Green has been hard at work adding additional tools to the map editor.  [/p][p]The map editor now supports a data-driven scripting layer (MDL) that lets designers define missions in JSON instead of GDScript. Authors can place and name tiles in the editor (e.g., startTile) and reference them directly in scripts for camera moves, spawn points, triggers, and objectives. The system covers dialog, conditional logic via flags, unit spawning and AI strategies, timed waves, build restrictions, quest progression, and lightweight UI widgets (like turn countdowns).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004847/35e0cd38263f7dc427ecaebf4b5b848fcf2a8f61.png"][/img][/p][p]In short, the editor now enables [b]end-to-end mission creation[/b]—from terrain and points of interest to scripted encounters and win/loss logic—so teams (or players, if we expose it) can create, share, and play custom campaigns with no code changes.[/p][p][/p][p]We look forward to getting these tools into players' hands to see what they come up with![/p]

notes.title: Mordfield Command's Release Target Acquired
notes.content:
[p]Greetings Meaty![/p][p][/p][p]We’ve locked in our [i]target[/i] release date — [b]October 2025[/b].[/p][p]
At this point, there are very few reasons we’d delay. The finish line is in sight, and we’re charging straight for it.[/p][p][/p][p]Sharpen your strategies. Stock up on courage. The rebellion begins this October![/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy the teaser below while we prepare our launch trailer! :)[/p][previewyoutube="aNDwCfJL1Hw;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Mordfield Command Update: Continue the Fight, Meaty!
notes.content:
[p]Welcome back, Meaty![/p][p][/p][p]We have released an update to our demo and early access builds!   [/p][p]
Changes include: [/p][p]-Significant Performance Update [/p][p]-In-Game HUD rework [/p][p]-Color scheme changes [/p][p]-UI/Menu polishing [/p][p]-A Number of Bug fixes[/p][p][/p][p]There have been some minor changes to the intro story, but the campaign is not yet complete.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004847/8522fd6c6beac1db30ed1a34fa69fe9f79d96472.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004847/2525378a23f4160ba36a0d37e642609705a1dee0.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004847/d2a4470c9fdf4ff1946b8157032ffeb4ac548f65.png"][/img] [/p]

notes.title: Time to take a stand, Meaty!
notes.content:
We have published a new version of the demo to our steam page following PAX East.  This demo allows players to choose from the starting resources. We are unsure how long we will keep this version up.

ENJOY!

Minor graphical changes and QOL improvements.

-Fog of war replaced.
-Changes made to hill terrain, model and texture both updated.


-The demo now allows players to choose from one of three starting resources.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004847/711a213eedeec11a220affe5cd892b5673a24694.png[/img]

notes.title: Mordfield Command: Developer Stream STEAM NEXT FEST
notes.content: Welcome to [b]Mordfield Command[/b], Meaty!  We're going through the tutorial and demo together.  Learn some strategies from one of the makers.  Time to fight back against the algorithm and take back what's ours!
